hints.text: Think of the second factor as tens and ones. Each part gives its own partial product, and the two get added at the end.
Split $36$ into $30 + 6$. You need $458 \times 6$ and $458 \times 30$, and the second is $458 \times 3$ with a zero attached.
$458 \times 6 = 2{,}748$ and $458 \times 30 = 13{,}740$, and their sum is $16{,}488$, so the product is $16{,}488$.

explanation: Split $36$ into $30 + 6$ so that each part can be multiplied on its own.
Multiply by the ones part first: $458 \times 6 = 2{,}748$.
Multiply by the tens part next: $458 \times 3 = 1{,}374$, so $458 \times 30 = 13{,}740$.
